WHY_IT_MAY_HELP_CONFIRMED: Not confirmed as a speedup. The bit-identity claim IS confirmed (12/12 IDENTICAL). Removing the Muls copy + mid-chain barrier per unit did not produce a measurable window on this machine at this resolution.
WHY_IT_MAY_FAIL_OBSERVED: The pre-registered failure mode materialized: pass-1 is not bound by V-op throughput at this site. Deleting one full-tile Muls and one mid-chain PipeBarrier per unit changes nothing measurable, which means the MTE2 load / reduce chain, not the V instruction stream, sets the pass-1 pace for these shapes. Consequence for the hypothesis pool: the section 0.1 rule that priced mid-chain barriers at ~0.07us/unit (from the R31A V024 five-barrier result) does not transfer to this FP16 pass-1 site; at this site the barrier is ~0.01us class or free. H4 (pass-2 BF16 widen deletion, 2 Cast + 1 PB/tile) is priced at 0.1-0.4us on a similar op-deletion mechanism and should be re-checked against this finding before being run; H3 (full-sync removal) and H5 (MTE2 staging depth) are unaffected because they act on the actual suspected bottleneck (DMA/sync), not V ops.
